description: Review and maintain reusable Terraform modules against a written profile of the module family's rules: pull request review with one verdict, findings-only review of a local change, and a maintainer skill that makes the change.

interface.longDescription: Agent skills that review a change to a reusable Terraform module rule by rule against the terraform-aws-modules profile: breaking changes, provider schema coverage and whether each addition belongs. Every rule they could not check is listed, never counted as a pass.
interface.shortDescription: Review Terraform module pull requests against written rules.

name: modulestf
